info.title: ОНСОФТ AI — проверяемые ответы по закупкам
info.description: AI-side service: immutable source snapshots, evidence tools, bounded repair, durable run events and organizer CSV export. Django owns end-user authentication. WebSocket contract: ai/README.md.

post.description: Chats with documents use AI_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (default 1200 seconds), capped at 3600 seconds, for the complete harness run including planning and checking. Chats without documents retain the 600-second default. The configured server deadline remains an upper bound in both modes. Effective limits are in GET /info. Independent verification retries a transient provider failure once. In document chats, if that provider remains unavailable, factual answers that passed code checks retain their text and citations, with reason=independent_review_incomplete and a failed review_unavailable check. This does not mark AI verification as passed. Absence claims and comparison runs still require the independent verification.

get.description:
Owner-scoped canonical extraction. Offsets use Unicode code points, exclusive end.

Expected hash/version prevent navigating a quote against changed source text.
This endpoint is service-key authenticated and returns no storage paths.

clarification_question.title: Clarification Question
clarification_question.description: Question to ask the user when status is 'не знаю' because the referent is ambiguous. This is not a factual answer.

system_prompt.title: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: System prompt from the backend user profile, supported in plain/harness modes. Null or omitted uses that mode's built-in prompt. Server limits and harness checks are controlled separately.

additional_instructions.title: Additional Instructions
additional_instructions.description: Profile instructions appended to built-in plain/harness rules, as in Django chat. Forbidden in baseline/raw.

model.title: Model
model.description: Optional model ID. Omitted/null uses APIMIRA_MODEL from .env; default openai/gpt-6-luna. Explicit IDs are sent to the configured provider.

base_url.title: Base Url
base_url.description: Optional provider API base URL, including /v1. Omitted/null uses APIMIRA_BASE_URL from .env; default https://apimira.com/v1. Overrides must be enabled via AI_ALLOWED_BASE_URLS; API keys are never accepted in this field.

question.title: Question
question.description: Complete user message. With documents the model selects up to 50 independently checked answer units; no line/CSV/keyword question splitter is used. Code checks lossless coverage and assigns message_id.q01, .q02 IDs. One unit keeps message_id. The entire original message remains shared context; planning shares the run's call/time budget. Without documents the message is answered directly.
